name: SDD Plan Template (Atomic 70-Task Structure)
description: Comprehensive implementation plan template based on SDD methodology with atomic 70-task structure (25-20-15-10 tasks) using explicit verification and mandatory proof requirements. Includes all 26 constitutional gates with RED-GREEN-REFACTOR-SMOKE enforcement.

summary.title: Summary
summary.instruction: Extract from feature spec: primary requirement + technical approach. Focus on business value and user outcomes.

technicalContext.title: Technical Context
technicalContext.instruction: Extract the complete technology stack from the user input and specification. Include ALL technologies mentioned, organized by category. Do not add technologies not mentioned. Do not omit technologies that were mentioned. Create a comprehensive technical context that captures exactly what was specified.

edgeCaseAnalysis.title: Edge Case Analysis
edgeCaseAnalysis.instruction: Analyze edge cases from specification. Extract edge cases, categorize by complexity, and estimate additional development time. Include specific edge cases that need special attention during implementation.

simplicityGate.title: Simplicity Gate
simplicityGate.instruction: Validate ≤10 projects for initial scope. If exceeded, force simplification or document in Complexity Tracking.

architectureGate.title: Architecture Gate
architectureGate.instruction: Ensure every feature starts as standalone library with CLI interface (for developer/system tools). UI/app layers are thin veneers.

testingGate.title: Testing Gate (NON-NEGOTIABLE)
testingGate.instruction: Enforce TDD order: Contract → Integration → E2E → Unit → Implementation → UI-API Integration. Prefer real dependencies over mocks.

platformSpecificGates.title: Platform-Specific Gates
platformSpecificGates.instruction: Validate platform-specific gates based on selected platform. Include API-First for web/mobile/backend platforms.

projectStructure.title: Project Structure
projectStructure.instruction: 🚨 MANDATORY PROJECT STRUCTURE: Define the EXACT folder structure that MUST be followed during implementation. Include specific directory names, file naming conventions, and organizational rules. This structure will be strictly enforced during implementation - NO DEVIATIONS ALLOWED. Follow SDD path conventions with lib/[feature-name]/, contracts/, tests/ structure.
projectStructure.template:
src/
├── lib/[feature-name]/          # Library implementation
│   ├── models/                  # Data models
│   ├── services/                # Business logic
│   └── cli.(ts|py|rs|go)        # Command interface
├── contracts/                   # API specifications
└── tests/
    ├── contract/                # Contract tests
    ├── integration/             # Integration tests
    └── unit/                    # Unit tests
projectStructure.enforcement: This project structure is MANDATORY and must be followed exactly during implementation. Any deviation will result in implementation failure.

implementationPhases.title: Implementation Phases (Atomic 70-Task Structure with Mandatory Verification)
implementationPhases.taskApproach: Atomic tasks with explicit action verbs (EXECUTE, RUN, COMPILE, SHOW, CONFIRM) and mandatory proof requirements. RED-GREEN-REFACTOR-SMOKE pattern enforced.
implementationPhases.verificationFramework: Every task requires proof of execution (terminal output, file counts, test results). Forbidden states prevent AI from gaming the system.

phase1.title: Phase 1: Foundations & Data (25 tasks: TASK-001 to TASK-025)
phase1.instruction: Essential foundation work with atomic verification: API contracts (OpenAPI with validation proof), database setup (Prisma migrations with SQL shown), data models (TypeScript compilation with 0 errors). Each task requires proof: contracts must validate, tests must RED then GREEN, app must start and respond (200 OK). Pattern: Define contracts → Create tests (RED) → Implement code (GREEN) → Verify complete system (SMOKE).

phase2.title: Phase 2: Core Implementation (20 tasks: TASK-026 to TASK-045)
phase2.pattern: Core Library (RED→GREEN) → Services (RED→GREEN) → Controllers (RED→GREEN) → Auth (RED→GREEN) → Integration → SMOKE
phase2.instruction: Core library, services, controllers, and authentication with RED-GREEN-SMOKE pattern per component. Each component follows strict RED (tests fail) → GREEN (tests pass with ≥80% coverage) cycle. NO MOCK IMPLEMENTATIONS. Proof required: terminal output showing test execution, coverage reports, compilation success. Final SMOKE test demonstrates all systems operational.

phase3.title: Phase 3: UI Development with Real APIs (15 tasks: TASK-046 to TASK-060)
phase3.pattern: Platform Setup → Design System (RED→GREEN) → Components (RED→GREEN) → Real API Integration (RED→GREEN) → Visual Testing → SMOKE
phase3.instruction: UI components with REAL API integration (NO MOCKS ALLOWED). Pattern: Configure platform → Design system (RED→GREEN) → Components (RED→GREEN) → Real API services (RED→GREEN with network proof) → Visual regression testing (screenshots shown) → Complete SMOKE test. Proof required: build success, real HTTP calls (grep count), network requests/responses shown, visual test screenshots generated.

phase4.title: Phase 4: Comprehensive Testing & Deployment (10 tasks: TASK-061 to TASK-070)
phase4.pattern: Test All Suites → Verify Application → Performance → Security → Accessibility → Cleanup → Coverage → Documentation → Final Sign-off
phase4.instruction: Complete testing and production readiness verification. ALL test suites executed (contract+unit+integration+E2E+visual) with 0 failures shown. Application startup demonstrated (200 OK required). Manual smoke tests documented (3-5 journeys). Performance benchmarks verified (load <3s, API <100ms). Security audit (0 vulnerabilities). Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA). Coverage ≥90%. Final sign-off with COMPLETE PROOF TRAIL. NO SHORTCUTS - every verification must be demonstrated.

databaseStrategy.title: Database Strategy
databaseStrategy.description: Comprehensive database design and implementation planning

databaseChoice.title: Database Technology Choice
databaseChoice.instruction: Choose appropriate enterprise-grade database technology based on project requirements

schemaDesign.title: Schema Design Planning
schemaDesign.instruction: Design enterprise-grade schema: tables/collections, relationships, indexes, constraints, data types, normalization level.

migrationStrategy.title: Migration Strategy
migrationStrategy.instruction: Plan database migrations: version control, rollback strategy, data migration, schema evolution, environment management.

connectionManagement.title: Connection Management
connectionManagement.instruction: Plan connection management: connection pooling, timeout handling, retry logic, failover, monitoring, resource cleanup.

apiFirstPlanning.title: API-First Planning (Web/Mobile/Backend)
apiFirstPlanning.description: Comprehensive API design and implementation planning

apiDesign.title: API Design Planning
apiDesign.instruction: Plan RESTful/GraphQL API design: endpoint structure, resource modeling, HTTP methods, status codes, API consistency.

apiContracts.title: API Contract Planning
apiContracts.instruction: Plan API contracts: request/response schemas, validation rules, error handling, data types, contract completeness.

apiTesting.title: API Testing Planning
apiTesting.instruction: Plan API testing: contract testing, integration testing, performance testing, security testing, test automation.

visualTesting.title: Visual Regression Testing Planning
visualTesting.instruction: Plan visual regression testing: Playwright setup, baseline screenshot capture, cross-browser testing, responsive design validation, visual consistency checks, CI/CD integration.

projectStructurePlanning.title: Project Structure Planning
projectStructurePlanning.instruction: Plan project structure validation and cleanup: empty folder detection, legacy code removal, technology stack consistency, architecture pattern enforcement, final structure validation.

apiDocumentation.title: API Documentation Planning
apiDocumentation.instruction: Plan API documentation: OpenAPI specification, versioning strategy, migration approach, developer experience.

mobile.title: Mobile Platform Planning
mobile.instruction: Plan mobile-specific features: native capabilities, offline strategy, performance targets, accessibility, security, store compliance.

web.title: Web Platform Planning
web.instruction: Plan web-specific features: progressive enhancement, responsive design, browser compatibility, performance optimization, accessibility.

desktop.title: Desktop Platform Planning
desktop.instruction: Plan desktop-specific features: OS integration, distribution strategy, performance optimization, accessibility, security.

backend.title: Backend Platform Planning
backend.instruction: Plan backend-specific features: API design, database design, monitoring strategy, security, performance, scalability.

ai.title: AI Platform Planning
ai.instruction: Plan AI-specific features: data quality, model performance, reproducibility, ethics compliance, deployment strategy.

complexityTracking.title: Complexity Tracking
complexityTracking.description: Use only when a constitutional gate is intentionally broken
complexityTracking.instruction: If any constitutional gate is violated, document: 1) What was violated, 2) Why it was necessary, 3) Why simpler alternatives won't work

simplicityGate.title: Simplicity Gate
simplicityGate.description: ≤ 10 projects for initial scope; otherwise, force simplification

libraryFirstGate.title: Library-First Gate
libraryFirstGate.description: Every feature starts as a standalone library (desktop/backend) or modular component (web/mobile/embedded). UI/app layers are thin veneers over core functionality

cliInterfaceGate.title: CLI Interface Gate
cliInterfaceGate.description: Each developer/system tool library exposes a CLI with --json mode using stdin/stdout; errors go to stderr

testFirstGate.title: Test-First Gate
testFirstGate.description: No implementation before tests; sequence is Contract → Integration → E2E → Unit → Implementation → UI-API Integration

antiAbstractionGate.title: Anti-Abstraction Gate
antiAbstractionGate.description: One domain model (avoid DTO/Repository/Unit-of-Work unless truly necessary)

traceabilityGate.title: Traceability Gate
traceabilityGate.description: Every line of code must trace back to a numbered requirement (FR-XXX) in the spec

nativeFirstGate.title: Native-First Gate
nativeFirstGate.description: Use platform-native capabilities and patterns. Avoid cross-platform frameworks unless justified

offlineFirstGate.title: Offline-First Gate
offlineFirstGate.description: Core functionality works without internet. Local data storage and sync when online

performanceGate.title: Performance Gate
performanceGate.description: Platform-specific performance requirements: Mobile (60fps, <3s launch, <100MB), Web (<3s load, <100ms interaction), Desktop (<2s startup, <50MB base)

accessibilityGate.title: Accessibility Gate
accessibilityGate.description: Full accessibility support: Mobile (screen reader, touch), Web (WCAG 2.1 AA), Desktop (OS accessibility features)

securityGate.title: Security Gate
securityGate.description: Platform-specific security: Mobile (encryption, secure storage), Web (HTTPS, CSP, XSS/CSRF), Backend (auth, validation), Desktop (code signing, sandboxing)

storeComplianceGate.title: Store Compliance Gate
storeComplianceGate.description: App store guidelines and review readiness for mobile apps

progressiveEnhancementGate.title: Progressive Enhancement Gate
progressiveEnhancementGate.description: Works without JavaScript, then enhances with JS. Graceful degradation

responsiveDesignGate.title: Responsive Design Gate
responsiveDesignGate.description: Mobile-first design with breakpoints for tablet and desktop. All screen sizes supported

browserCompatibilityGate.title: Browser Compatibility Gate
browserCompatibilityGate.description: Works on Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge. 95% of target browsers supported

nativeIntegrationGate.title: Native Integration Gate
nativeIntegrationGate.description: Integrate with OS features: menus, notifications, file associations, system preferences

distributionGate.title: Distribution Gate
distributionGate.description: Installer, auto-updates, and uninstaller. Code signing and update mechanisms

apiFirstGate.title: API-First Gate
apiFirstGate.description: RESTful/GraphQL APIs with OpenAPI specs. API documentation and versioning. All features expose well-defined APIs

databaseGate.title: Database Gate
databaseGate.description: Proper schema design, migrations, indexing, and data integrity

monitoringGate.title: Monitoring Gate
monitoringGate.description: Logging, metrics, health checks, and observability

dataQualityGate.title: Data Quality Gate
dataQualityGate.description: Clean, validated, representative datasets. Data preprocessing and validation

modelPerformanceGate.title: Model Performance Gate
modelPerformanceGate.description: Accuracy, precision, recall metrics. Model evaluation and benchmarking

reproducibilityGate.title: Reproducibility Gate
reproducibilityGate.description: Deterministic training, version control, and experiment tracking

ethicsGate.title: Ethics Gate
ethicsGate.description: Bias detection, fairness, explainability, and ethical AI principles

deploymentGate.title: Deployment Gate
deploymentGate.description: Model serving, monitoring, rollback, and production deployment

sddPrinciples.intentBeforeMechanism: Focus on WHAT and WHY before HOW
sddPrinciples.multiStepRefinement: Use iterative refinement over one-shot generation
sddPrinciples.cliInterfaceMandate: Every developer/system tool capability has CLI with --json mode
sddPrinciples.traceability: Every line of code traces to numbered requirement
sddPrinciples.businessFacing: Plans are for technical stakeholders but business-aligned
sddPrinciples.atomicTasks: 70 sequential tasks with explicit action verbs (EXECUTE, RUN, COMPILE, SHOW, CONFIRM)
sddPrinciples.mandatoryVerification: Every task requires proof of execution - terminal output, file counts, test results
sddPrinciples.antiGaming: Forbidden states and expected states prevent AI from bypassing verification

atomicTaskFramework.title: Atomic Task Framework (70 Tasks Total)

verificationTypes.test_creation_confirmation: SHOW test files created, test count, compilation success
verificationTypes.test_execution_red_phase: EXECUTE tests, CONFIRM RED (X failed, 0 passing)
verificationTypes.test_execution_green_phase: EXECUTE tests, CONFIRM GREEN (0 failed, X passing, coverage ≥80%)
verificationTypes.implementation_with_green_verification: IMPLEMENT code, COMPILE, EXECUTE tests, SHOW GREEN
verificationTypes.comprehensive_smoke_test: EXECUTE all checks (tests+build+health+lint), SHOW all pass
verificationTypes.setup_verification: CONFIGURE environment, BUILD successfully, SHOW config files
verificationTypes.visual_test_execution: EXECUTE visual regression tests, SHOW screenshots generated
verificationTypes.integration_test_execution: EXECUTE integration tests with real dependencies, SHOW GREEN
verificationTypes.complete_test_suite_execution: EXECUTE ALL test suites, SHOW 0 failures total
verificationTypes.application_startup_verification: START application, SHOW health check 200 OK
verificationTypes.manual_testing_documentation: EXECUTE manual tests, DOCUMENT results with screenshots
verificationTypes.performance_test_execution: EXECUTE performance tests, SHOW benchmarks met
verificationTypes.accessibility_test_execution: EXECUTE accessibility tests, SHOW WCAG compliance
verificationTypes.cleanup_verification: EXECUTE cleanup, SHOW no empty folders, lint passes
verificationTypes.documentation_completeness: CREATE final documentation, SHOW all proof attached
verificationTypes.final_production_readiness: EXECUTE final verification, CONFIRM production ready with complete proof trail

proofRequirements.mustInclude: Specific strings that must appear in proof (e.g., 'passing', '0 failed', '200 OK')
proofRequirements.mustShow: What must be demonstrated (e.g., 'Complete test run output', 'Health check response')

atomicTaskFramework.cannotProceedWithout: Gate conditions that must be met before advancing (e.g., 'Confirmed test failures', 'Passing tests with coverage', 'Working application')
atomicTaskFramework.aiWarnings: Explicit instructions to prevent gaming (e.g., 'Tests MUST fail. DO NOT implement yet.', 'MUST show 0 compilation errors.')

sddVersion.description: Atomic 70-task implementation plan with mandatory verification framework and anti-gaming mechanisms based on asy-sdd.md with all 26 constitutional gates
